Test Mode: Stock Diagnostic Lab GENUINE OHLCV VAULT

Test any NSE equity against institutional Buy Now, Breakout, and Pullback standard criteria. Zero mock numbers.

Standard Criteria & Threshold Blueprints (Required Benchmark Values) Select card to view diagnostic rules
1. BUY NOW CRITERIA

Institutional 6-Pillar & VDU

Strict swing setup requiring bullish EMA stack, healthy RSI, volume dry-up contraction, tight base, and institutional liquidity.

Trend Alignment: Close > 20 > 50 > 200 EMA
RSI (14) Momentum: 50.0 - 75.0 (Optimal)
T-1 Volume Dry-Up: <= 0.80x 20D Avg
T-1 Daily Tightness: <= 3.50% Range
52W High Proximity: Within 15.0%
Min Market Cap / Vol: >= ₹300 Cr | ₹1 Cr/d
2. BREAKOUT CRITERIA

Stage-2 Momentum Breakout

High-energy expansion clearing key resistance pivots with massive institutional relative volume expansion.

20D Pivot Resistance: LTP >= 20D Pivot High
Relative Volume Surge: >= 1.50x 20D Avg Vol
Candle Range Expansion: >= 1.20x 14D ATR
Closing Strength: Upper 35% of Range
Base Proximity: Distance to 20 EMA <= 5%
RSI Range: 55.0 - 80.0
3. PULLBACK CRITERIA

EMA Retest & Orderly Dip

Low-risk dip entries in established uptrends where price pulls back cleanly to rising 20 or 50 EMA on declining volume.

Structural Uptrend: 50 EMA > 200 EMA
EMA Support Zone: Within 2.0% of 20 EMA
Dip Volume Drying Up: <= 0.90x 20D Avg Vol
Pullback RSI Range: 42.0 - 58.0
Reversal Candlestick: Lower Shadow / Rejection
Max Pullback Depth: Must hold above 50 EMA

Exact Stop-Loss & Price-Triggered Re-Entry Architecture (Per-Leg State Machine)

Reference Anchor: Original Entry Premium P0 (NOT Index Spot)
1 Initial Sell Entry
Sell Option @ P0 (e.g. ₹100)

Leg set to ACTIVE. Calculate initial stop trigger: P0 × (1 + SL%) = ₹130 (30% SL) or ₹140 (40% SL).

2 Stop-Loss Exit
Premium reaches SL Trigger

Trigger buy exit on executable quotes (handling gap slippage). Record actual exit fill. State → SL_EXITED.

3 Monitor Same Strike
Track Contract & Quotes

Do not require a new prediction. Continuous watchdog monitors live bid/ask quotes for the exact same strike.

4 Price-Triggered Re-Entry
Premium ≤ P0 (e.g. ≤ ₹100)

Submit new sell order. Strictly 1 re-entry per cycle. New SL trigger = Actual Re-entry Fill × (1 + SL%). State → RE_ENTERED.

5 Final Exit / MOC Decay
Final SL or 15:25 MOC

If re-entered leg hits new SL → FINAL_SL_EXITED (no more re-entries). Else hold into afternoon theta decay for full credit.
